messages:
ash: Hey team — opened a PR to backport an experimental feature into release/v1.2. It touches schemas/user_meta.yaml and experimental/feature_x/handler.py. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4567. CODEOWNERS doesn't match experimental/* — who should approve this for a patch backport?

taylor: Are we talking a prod merge or just a maintenance backport?

ash: Backport to release/v1.2 (patch). It's blocking a customer fix. Small code change but the schema tweak could impact downstream services.

dev-bot: CI status: unit ✓, lint ✓, e2e pending — https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7890

morgan: If the schema file changed, data infra should at least eyeball it. experimental/* isn't owned by anyone in CODEOWNERS afaik. Ping @priya from data infra?

priya: I can review the schema. We don't currently own experimental/* patterns — default would be runtime. @taylor is runtime ok with this?

taylor: Runtime should own the handler change. For schema changes that affect multiple services, prefer runtime + data infra approval. If you need to unblock, runtime approval + follow-up from data infra is acceptable for a patch.

ash: Is there a quick explicit approver list for these cases? Who in runtime can proxy approve? Also can I add experimental/* to CODEOWNERS in the same PR to make future routing clearer?

morgan: You can add a CODEOWNERS file in the PR, but it won't apply retroactively to the existing PR protections. Practically, mention a specific reviewer (e.g., @taylor) and get their sign-off in the thread — that's the fastest unblock.

taylor: I can take the runtime review today. If @priya signs off on the schema afterward, that's fine. If you want release-engineering to fast-track the backport, add label `critical-backport` and ping release-ops.

ash: Thanks — assigning to @taylor for runtime review now and adding `critical-backport`. I'll leave a short changelog and follow-up TODO to update CODEOWNERS for experimental/*.

merge-bot: merge-bot: Merge allowed when approvals >= 2 and all e2e checks pass.

priya: Quick schema nit: prefer renaming created_at_v2 -> created_at to avoid duplicate fields across services. Small change, I'll approve after you update.

ash: Updated the field name and pushed a new commit. @taylor please review runtime bits. Adding a NOTE in the PR: "follow up: add experimental/* to CODEOWNERS". Thanks all :thumbsup:

morgan: :thumbsup: Good call adding the CODEOWNERS TODO, that'll prevent another mystery approver case.
